snippet.title: Pack a Plush! 🧸 Release Date Trailer | October 28th
snippet.description:
🧸 Turn your love for plushies into a cozy little paradise in Pack a Plush!

Collect adorable plushies, unpack batches, pack orders for customers, and hunt for rare and legendary plushies as you build your very own plushie paradise. ✨

🛍️ WISHLIST ON STEAM: store.steampowered.com/app/5123900/Pack_a_Plush/

🎮 RELEASE DATE: October 28th
Celebrate International Plushie Day by diving into Pack a Plush!

💕 TRY THE DEMO: Available October 19th!

#PackAPlush #CozyGames #IndieGame
